goal: Prevent nodes from busy-spinning on TCP urgent data during select() polling
Stop established sockets from monitoring exceptions while preserving error checks during connection setup
agreement: Concept approval for only setting the exception set when checking connection errors (theuni, darosior)
Support for removing select() exception monitoring to stop looping on urgent data (midnightmagic)
Unaddressed objection: FuzzedSock implementation contradicts EventFlag documentation (darosior)
Contested objection: added functional tests are brittle and test urgent data progress instead of the bug (darosior)
Wants to trim the PR down to the core bug fix and unit test, moving cleanups to follow-ups (darosior, theuni)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because it prevents continuous CPU busy-spinning and stalled progress when peers send urgent data
Protects node availability by stopping unread out-of-band data from repeatedly triggering select() events
